title: The NeuroPro Playbook: Partner Training for MoveDocs

voiceover.text: Welcome to the NeuroPro Playbook, a quick primer for our partners at MoveDocs before training.

NeuroPro is a national concussion clinic, providing concussion care, neuropsychological testing, and mental health care. Our team has seen more than a hundred fifty thousand head injuries, we're licensed in forty-six states, and most clients are seen within seven to ten days.

NeuroPro was founded more than fifteen years ago by Doctor Anthony Doran, a neuropsychologist with a twenty-year Navy career, who taught at the Naval Academy and Johns Hopkins, and helped pass Maryland's concussion law. What started as one doctor is now close to thirty clinicians, serving clients across the country.

Your job is simple. You don't need to diagnose anything, just recognize when something isn't right: a head injury, anxiety or poor sleep after a crash, or a client who needs testing. Then send the referral.

One referral puts the client into one coordinated network: a concussion evaluation, neuropsychological testing, mental health treatment, and medico-legal support, with one team from intake through trial.

The most common pushback is a clean scan. But most concussions don't show up on a CT or MRI. A neurologist checks whether the brain is damaged. NeuroPro measures what that damage does to the client's life.
And be careful with a DTI. It's discoverable, and if it comes back normal, the defense calls it no damage. Lead with a NeuroPro evaluation, and add imaging only if it helps.

You'll hear the same questions again and again. The accident was a while ago? It's not too late. The defense says the client is faking? Our testing has built-in effort checks. Who pays? Injury cases can go on a lien through MoveDocs.
Sending a client is simple: spot the need, send the referral, and we take it from there. When a client has a head injury, or anything affecting their mental health, think NeuroPro.
Thank you for trusting us with your care.

endCard.tagline: Thank you for trusting us with your care.
